world.description: A rain-soaked downtown at night, lit window by window — find the five neon cats.

intro.objective: Walk the blocks and find the five neon cats hiding by the street.
intro.tagline: Rain, wet asphalt and a thousand lit windows. The city never sleeps.
intro.title: Neon Rain City

world.name: Neon Rain City

then.text: Five neon cats are hiding on these blocks. Find them all.
All five neon cats found. The city purrs.
